correctness.rationale: Direct coefficient matching cancels the three explicit triplet Fourier modes. Exact trigonometric reduction then gives a pairwise-additive phase field whose sync and splay transverse growth rates are controlled by the same quadratic factor with opposite signs; a standalone symbolic check verifies the identities.

originality.rationale: The primary source derives the motifs and uses an all-unit physical-motif design that only partially cancels the symmetric triplet term. Related work covers uncanceled higher-order stability and general harmonic realization, but no source-specific 1:1:2 cancellation with exact sync–splay threshold coincidence was found.

value.rationale: The result converts partial compensation into an exact second-order design using the existing motif-weight degrees of freedom and proves that this choice removes the local sync–splay stability overlap while quantifying the residual shift of the common transition.

disclaimer: Not independent validation, peer review, or a guarantee of first discovery.
